title: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte
summary: Bookmark this page for Rappler's comprehensive coverage of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial at the Senate

blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte — the first Philippine public official to be impeached twice by the House of Representatives — began at 2 pm on Monday, July 6.

There are four articles of impeachment against Duterte involving alleged misuse of confidential funds, unexplained wealth, bribery of Department of Education officials, and grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family.

Only 21 out of 24 senator-judges are physically present. Senator Bato dela Rosa remains in hiding as he faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, Senator Jinggoy Estrada has been detained and suspended in connection with a plunder case, and Senator Rodante Marcoleta surrendered to authorities as he also faces a plunder case.
On this page, we bring you the latest updates, analyses, videos, and photos as the trial of the Vice President unfolds.

blocks.text: 14 hours ago
Was the prosecution’s direct examination of Baste Duterte anti-climactic?

Constitutional lawyer and law professor Lulu Reyes says the prosecution visibly had a hard time proving the connection between Vice President Sara Duterte and Gencorp Industries, Inc. on Tuesday, September 29, or Day 31 of Duterte’s impeachment trial.
“They did not even reach the doorstep. Medyo malayo pa siya, siguro nandoon pa lang sa kapitbahay banda,” Reyes says.

blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

blocks.text: 16 hours ago
Ridon: Baste testimony bolsters Gencorp links to Dutertes

House prosecutor Terry Ridon says Davao City Mayor Baste Duterte’s testimony confirmed the city government’s contracts with Gencorp, which the prosecution says are relevant to allegations of unexplained wealth against Vice President Sara Duterte, on Tuesday, September 29. In an interview with Rappler, Ridon also points to businessman Jaime T. Cruz’s links to Gencorp and another company involving Baste and his brother, Paolo Duterte, as an area warranting further scrutiny. Ridon says the prosecution may still consider calling Cruz as a witness.

blocks.text: Trillanes: If Baste’s view accepted, then mayors can contract siblings

Former senator Antonio “Sonny” Trillanes IV says that if Davao City Mayor Baste Duterte’s view is accepted, all mayors could have government contracts with their siblings. He made the remark after the 31st day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Tuesday, September 29.

blocks.text: 17 hours ago
Baste Duterte claims no direct hand in Gencorp deals with Davao City

Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte distanced himself from his city government’s deals with Gencorp during his testimony at Vice President Sara Duterte‘s impeachment trial on Tuesday, September 29.
He consistently maintained that he had no direct hand in the contracts sealed with the company linked to the Vice President, his older sister — a claim the prosecution found hard to believe.
Tolosa says impeachment court admonished him over remarks
Prosecution legal spokesperson Jay Tolosa says he respects but disagrees with the Senate impeachment court’s admonition over comments he made during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial.
